test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per Deloitte, how much will AI in healthcare boost India’s GDP by 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USD 25–30 billion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to a report by **Deloitte**, the adoption of **Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the healthcare sector** is expected to significantly contribute to **India's GDP**.
 
• The report estimates that AI in healthcare will boost **India's GDP by USD 25–30 billion** by **2025**.
 
• This prediction highlights the transformative potential of AI in improving healthcare delivery, administrative processes, and overall economic productivity in the country. *Hence, the correct option is USD 25–30 billion.*
 
• The adoption of AI in healthcare includes applications like **predictive analytics, disease diagnosis, personalized treatment plans, and operational efficiency**, which can lead to better outcomes and cost savings.
 
• The usage of AI technologies is expected to contribute to the growth of the healthcare sector and indirectly impact other industries, thus promoting economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare:**

 
 
• **AI technologies** like **machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision** are being deployed in healthcare to enhance patient care and improve operational efficiency.
 
• Applications include **early disease detection, remote patient monitoring, telemedicine, drug discovery, and robotic surgeries**.
 
• AI can also aid in addressing challenges in healthcare like **staff shortages, improving diagnostics, and optimizing treatment costs.**
 
 
 
• **Impact on India’s Economy:**
 
 
• The integration of AI in healthcare will lead to higher efficiency, better accessibility, and improved outcomes, contributing to overall **economic productivity**.
 
• **Healthcare spending** is one of the critical drivers for economic growth, and advancements in AI can help reduce costs while improving service delivery.
 
• Boosting GDP by **USD 25–30 billion** by **2025** reflects the economic potential of technology-driven innovation in the healthcare domain.
 
 
 
• **Examples of AI in Healthcare:**
 
 
• **IBM Watson Health:** A platform that uses AI to assist in cancer diagnosis and treatment.
 
• **Google Health:** AI algorithms used in medical imaging and electronic health records.
 
• **NITI Aayog in India:** Advocates the use of AI in healthcare for improving accessibility in remote areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Drivers for AI Adoption in Healthcare:**

 
 
• India faces challenges like **low doctor-to-patient ratio**, infrastructure gaps, and rising healthcare costs. AI can address these issues by improving efficiency.
 
• **Government initiatives:** Programs like **Ayushman Bharat** aim to provide affordable healthcare, and AI can play a significant role in achieving this goal.
 
 
 
• **Economic Benefits:**
 
 
• **Cost savings:** AI can help reduce administrative and operational costs.
 
• **Job creation:** AI in healthcare will also create new job opportunities in technology, data analysis, and medical research.
